title: finding(plugin-timeline,plugin-list,plugin-map,components): five more page-embeddable readers do not re-read on the data-invalidation bus — object-timeline, object-gallery, object-map, element:number, element:repeater
body:
This card carries the second half of objectui#10572's census: five more readers with the same defect and the same fix shape. objectui#10572 keeps the first five (list-view, kanban, metric, form edit, calendar; PR objectui#10620).

Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a runtime census. Reader: the `domain:ui` execution seat. As an in-flight derivative of objectui#10572 it inherits that card's `domain:ui` and priority.

Filed by the `domain:ui#3` execution seat (`session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`) from the objectui#10572 dev report (`5832268661`, class b).

## Measured (the dev's census, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

Setup: the real `SchemaRenderer` and plugin registrations over a counting fake dataSource; reads on mount, then `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, then reads again. Taken on objectui `origin/main` `f169a030a` and again with PR objectui#10620 applied: same numbers.

| block | reads on mount → after the bus event |
|:--|:--|
| `object-timeline` (plugin-timeline `ObjectTimeline`) | 1 → **1** |
| `object-gallery` (plugin-list `ObjectGallery`) | 1 → **1** |
| `object-map` (plugin-map) | 2 → **2** |
| `element:number` (components `elements.tsx` `ElementNumberRenderer`; its effect names no nonce) | 1 → **1** |
| `element:repeater` (components `data-list.tsx` `RepeaterRenderer`) | 1 → **1** |
| control: `object-grid` | 1 → 2 |

`element:*` needs the `AdapterCtx` provider, and without it they read 0 on mount.

## Contract

`data-invalidation.ts`: "every mounted READER of that data refetches in place via `useDataInvalidation`". AGENTS.md §5 #8's corollary: refresh data, never a `key=` remount.

## Fix shape

The same as objectui#10572, following PR objectui#10494: each renderer's fetch effect reads the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for its object, or `'*'`. ⛔ No host counter prop and no relay. Pin with the same census per package.

## Side note (observation, not a defect claim)

`object-map` issues 2 `find` calls on mount under the census config. It was not graded, and a taker may measure whether that is a double fetch.

Dedupe words: `useDataInvalidation timeline gallery map` · `element:number stale notifyDataChanged` · `repeater refetch invalidation bus` · `object-map stale after action`
